glossary.definition: (a) "Employee" means any individual employed by an employer.
glossary.source_title: Section 4113.85 - Matters subject to employer policy.

glossary.definition: (b) "Employer" means any individual, partnership, association, corporation, business trust, or any person or group of persons, acting in the interest of an employer in relation to an employee, but does not include the state, its instrumentalities, a political subdivision of the state, or an instrumentality of a political subdivision.
glossary.source_title: Section 4113.85 - Matters subject to employer policy.
